outputs.discrepancies: replicability out of context: Panel A is a schematic depiction of the Drosophila ovariole/germarium and no tabular data are expected or required; image content matches the caption.
replicability out of context: Panel B is a schematic of the genetic screen and not derived from tabular data; image content (genes and process stages) matches the caption.

replicability out of context: Panel C are microscopy images (micrographs) — raw .tif image files are present for control and each GKD genotype matching the caption, so numeric reconstruction from tabular data is not applicable.

Panel D bars can be reproduced from the provided CSV of aggregated percentages (group labels match the caption), but the CSV contains only group-level percent values (no raw replicate-level data, no counts per ovary, and no p-values). The caption reports statistical tests (two-tailed t test; n = 50 per genotype) which cannot be reproduced from the aggregated percentage table; some listed percentages would imply non-integer counts if strictly using n=50, indicating rounding or missing raw counts.

no discrepancies found: DESeq2 result files for the three comparisons (log2FoldChange and padj columns present) allow reconstruction of volcano plots and identification of highlighted genes, but many padj values are encoded as 0 in the provided CSV previews (likely due to formatting/rounding) which should be clarified for exact -log10(padj) plotting.

empirical randomization test results (the P-value reported for three-way overlap) are not reproducible from the provided files alone: upregulated gene lists with a 'status' column are present and allow overlap counts, but the randomization outputs or code to reproduce the empirical P < 1e-6 are not included.

no discrepancies found: per-gene log2(TPM) values for the shared upregulated targets and the accompanying statistical contrast table are provided, enabling reproduction of distribution plots and the reported adjusted P-value annotations (minor plotting details such as violin kernel/smoothing are not specified but do not affect reproducibility of the reported statistics).

replicability out of context: the figure panel shows genome-browser style RPKM/coverage tracks but no coverage/BigWig or per-base/per-window track files are provided (only gene-level DESeq results), so raw reconstruction of track plots is not possible from supplied tables.

the downregulated-gene lists needed to compute overlaps are present in the DESeq result files, but the empirical randomization test (reported P-value for three-way overlap) and the randomization inputs/outputs are not provided so the reported significance cannot be independently reproduced from the tables alone.

no discrepancies found: per-gene log2(TPM) values for shared downregulated targets and the provided contrast/statistics table (adjusted P values and significance codes) permit reproduction of the distribution plots and significance annotations; plotting style specifics (violin kernel width) are not given but do not affect the core reproducibility of reported statistics.

replicability out of context: panel shows RPKM-normalized genome browser tracks for specific genes (wisp); no coverage/BigWig / per-base or per-window track files or processing scripts are provided in the tables, so the track visualizations cannot be reconstructed from the supplied CSV files.

Provided file 3AB_diff_expression.csv includes gene-level log2FC columns and a cluster label that can be used to reconstruct gene-sorted log2FC heatmaps, but it lacks chromatin-state annotations, explicit genomic coordinates/TAD assignments, and a defined threshold for calling 'upregulated' genes (so the reported Venn overlap count 658 cannot be independently confirmed).

The supplied 3AB_diff_expression.csv contains per-gene log2FC values appropriate for heatmap coloring but does not contain genomic coordinates, TAD assignments, or per-window (±3 kb) signal matrices required to create the TAD-centered heatmaps shown in the panel, so full replication of the TAD heatmaps is not possible from the file alone.

Expected data for Fig3C (chromatin-state matrices or counts by state for WT and knockdowns) is not present among the provided files (no Fig3C-specific tabular file found), so the chromatin-state heatmap cannot be reproduced.

replicability out of context: locus-level track coverage files (e.g., bigWig/bedGraph) or processed signal tables for the rps19b locus are not provided (no Fig3D data folder/files), so numeric reconstruction of the genome-browser tracks cannot be attempted.

replicability out of context: raw microscopy TIFFs are provided (rps19b-NG4 x nup44a RNAi.tif, rps19b-gfp control.tif) so image-level comparison is possible but numeric/table reconstruction is not applicable.

Panel-level trend (control shows no RpS19b-GFP expansion; nup44a GKD shows 100% expansion) matches the table, but the provided CSV lists values summing to 100 (appearing to be percentages) whereas the caption reports n=50 ovarioles per genotype and includes a Fisher's Exact Test P value which is not present in the table; replicate-level counts and the reported p-value are missing.

no discrepancies found: provided DESeq2 result CSV includes log2FoldChange and adjusted p-value (padj) allowing reconstruction of a volcano plot with significance thresholds (FDR < 0.05 and twofold change) as described in the caption; note that padj values of 0 may require special handling when computing -log10(padj).

partial reproducibility: upregulated gene list can be derived from the provided DESeq2 CSV for the Nup44A dataset, but the external comparison gene lists (ribosome-level and chromatin regulators referenced from Fig. 3) are not provided, so the Venn overlap counts cannot be fully reproduced.

replicability out of context: RPKM-normalized coverage/track files required to reproduce the per-locus heatmap/track plot are not provided, so numeric reconstruction of the displayed H3K9me3 track heatmap is not possible from the available files.

replicability out of context: the state-by-mark matrix underlying the small heatmap (states 1–10 vs marks) is not present as tabular data in the provided files, so the heatmap cannot be regenerated from available data.

replicability out of context: genome-browser-style coverage/profile plots require the underlying RPKM/coverage track files (not provided), so numeric reproduction of the H3K9me3 track plot for the rps19b locus is not possible from the supplied files.
